title: SCP-372, The Peripheral Jumper
description: Was there something? I saw something moved quickly... or did I?
body:
Peripheral Jumper adds a new monster. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-372, also known as The Peripheral Jumper.


SCP-372 resembles a grasshopper-like insect. It moves at incredible speeds, darting away from the player in unpredictable, fast movements. The creature is most commonly seen when it spawns curled up in front of the player, only to despawn moments later. However, be cautious, contact with SCP-372 results in significant damage.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-372 spawn?

SCP-372 can spawn anywhere in the overworld like a normal monster. However, there can only be one instance of SCP-372.

</details>



![SCP-372](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dba1b07b326ed5b3b9b3d9dade5f0332dca2b7d6.png)

SCP-372 is a grasshopper-like creature that moves extremely fast. It actively avoids players, sprinting away as soon as they get too close. However, because of its incredible speed, colliding with SCP-372 can deal significant damage to the player. Most of the time, SCP-372 appears as a curled-up entity that spawns infront the player before vanishing in an instant.
